final_boundary_requirements.title: Unstated Identity Provider Integration Boundary
final_boundary_requirements.description: The external upstream identity providers, enterprise directories (e.g., LDAP, Active Directory), or federation protocols (e.g., OIDC, SAML 2.0) are unstated.
final_boundary_requirements.justification: No mention of upstream identity federation or source-of-truth directories exists in the baseline specification.

final_boundary_requirements.title: Network Transport and API Protocol Unstated
final_boundary_requirements.description: The specific network protocols and transport mechanisms (e.g., gRPC, HTTPS/REST, WebSockets) utilized for authentication requests and revocation checks are unstated.
final_boundary_requirements.justification: The specification lacks any reference to the communication protocol or interface layer specifications.

final_boundary_requirements.title: Crash Recovery and Power Loss Invariant for Revocation State
final_boundary_requirements.description: The system must guarantee that durable revocation state records are successfully synchronized or flushed to non-volatile storage prior to acknowledging token issuance or revocation confirmation, preventing post-crash revocation state amnesia.
final_boundary_requirements.justification: Without durability guarantees upon unexpected power loss or abrupt node termination, revoked tokens could become un-revoked after a system restart, compromising security.

final_boundary_requirements.title: Graceful Shutdown and Drain Operational Boundary
final_boundary_requirements.description: During a graceful shutdown or deployment lifecycle event, the authentication platform must drain in-flight validation requests and complete pending token revocation propagations before terminating worker processes.
final_boundary_requirements.justification: To prevent request dropping or incomplete synchronization of revocation states during rolling deployments or scaling events, a graceful drain protocol is required.

- [REQ-MISSING-003] Revocation Store Storage Exhaustion and Pruning Policy (DERIVED_JUSTIFIED): The system must implement a retention and pruning policy for the token revocation state store to prevent unbounded growth and storage exhaustion.
